sourceEligibility: Recording/audio hash and physical lineage only. Actual Robust execution, output inspection, output-driven design, material prior H50 topology design, unknown pairing/history exclude. Truth-only inventory or non-H50 truth selection alone do not exclude.
truthGrouping: Existing first-NOTE_ON anchor <=35ms grouping, non-transitive; truth only, not acoustic H or STEP MIDI product policy. Note-on velocity zero is note-off.
ordering: Sort dataset then recordingId lexically, then physical onset and immutable gestureId. Select first eligible occurrence per family, never inspect acoustic output and never replace after selection.
singleBusyPair: Adjacent complete physical gestures [p] -> [p], 200 <= onset gapMs <=250. Both entire normalized pitch sets must be singleton and equal.
chordBusyPair: Adjacent complete physical gestures with exactly equal normalized sets of >=2 pitches, 50 < onset gapMs <=250; optional only if absent in all eligible sources.
postReadyRepeatOpportunity: Adjacent equal complete normalized pitch sets, onset gap >=1200ms and <=8000ms. This is prospective waiting topology only; actual READY must later be proven by causal product trace, never assumed PASS from MIDI.
multipleWrongThenCorrect: Three adjacent complete gestures with each onset gap >=1200ms and <=8000ms; last pitch set is target; both previous sets differ from it.
partialThenFull: Two adjacent complete physical gestures, onset gap >=1200ms and <=8000ms, first is a nonempty proper subset of the second full chord.
sustainGuards: First any-pitch NOTE_ON-free interval [previous group's last note-on+200ms, next note-on-100ms), at least1200ms. Prior complete set is singleton or chord as requested; every prior pitch is held across the entire scored guard or pedal is continuously down. Do not use model outputs to infer ringing energy.
counterfactuals: From selected physical complete chord P: exact P; subset removes highest pitch (EXTRA physical tone); superset adds lowest absent piano pitch (MISSING expected tone); semitone/octave replace highest with nearest absent +/-1 or +/-12, ascending numeric tie break, range21..108. All targets frozen before neural execution.
syntheticVersusPhysical: Equality contract tests are synthetic, never an empirical physical denominator. Busy/late scenarios reuse the fixed pair but are not independent performances. MIDI eligibility alone is never BUSY PASS or READY PASS.
missingMandatory: STOP. No relaxed gap, replacement source, H change, new resampler or acoustic output inspection.
scorer: scorer-contract.json; pure source/truth/trace scoring after future acoustic seal, no production controller execution this phase. No primary metrics are measured now.
